# Template reference assets

This directory preserves source reports, datasets, and prototype code used as
design and analytical references for EnergyIQ project-specific Renderers.

- These files are not runtime dependencies.
- Production Metrics must come from the Energy Data Foundation and a published
  Project Recipe, not from generated HTML or prototype mock data.
- Worker Worktrees should not start services from the reference prototype.
- Large generated outputs and dependency directories remain excluded by the
  repository ignore rules.

The maintained product decisions and implementation records remain under
`docs/energyiq/`.
